_description.summary: Vectors and geometry: construct and deconstruct vectors, get and set coordinates, normalize, distance, rotations and polar angles, range and approach, entity eye, foot, look and velocity, circle and sentinel positions, bounds, ship positions, quaternion and axis-angle conversions, length comparisons, block comparisons.
use_cases: Working with positions, directions and distances
Getting entity eye, foot or look positions

hexcasting:entity_pos/eye.d: Transforms an entity on the stack into the position of its eyes. I should probably use this on myself.

hexcasting:entity_pos/foot.d: Transforms an entity on the stack into the position it is standing. I should probably use this on other entities.

hexcasting:get_entity_look.d: Transforms an entity on the stack into the direction it's looking in, as a unit vector.

hexcasting:get_entity_velocity.d: Transforms an entity on the stack into the direction in which it's moving, with the speed of that movement as that direction's magnitude.

hexcasting:circle/impetus_pos.d: Returns the position of the Impetus of this spell circle.

hexcasting:circle/impetus_dir.d: Returns the direction the Impetus of this spell circle is facing as a unit vector.

hexcasting:circle/bounds/min.d: Returns the position of the lower-north-west corner of the bounds of this spell circle.

hexcasting:circle/bounds/max.d: Returns the position of the upper-south-east corner of the bounds of this spell circle.

hexcasting:construct_vec.d: Combine three numbers at the top of the stack into a vector's X, Y, and Z components (bottom to top).

hexcasting:deconstruct_vec.d: Split a vector into its X, Y, and Z components (bottom to top).

hexcasting:coerce_axial.d: For a vector, coerce it to its nearest axial direction, a unit vector. For a number, return the sign of the number; 1 if positive, -1 if negative. In both cases, zero is unaffected.

hexcasting:greater_eq.d: If the first argument is greater than or equal to the second, return True. Otherwise, return False. | If the first vector is longer or the same length as the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

hexcasting:less_eq.d: If the first argument is less than or equal to the second, return True. Otherwise, return False. | If the first vector is shorter or the same length as the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

hexcasting:blink.d:
Remove an entity and length from the stack, then teleport the given entity along its look vector by the given length.
Costs about one Amethyst Shard per two blocks travelled.

hexcasting:place_block.d:
Remove a location from the stack, then pick a block item and place it at the given location.
Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:create_water.d: Summon a block of water (or insert up to a bucket's worth) into a block at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:destroy_water.d: Drains either a liquid container at, or a body of liquid around, the given position. Costs about two Charged Amethyst.

hexcasting:ignite.d: Start a fire on top of the given location, as if a Fire Charge was applied, or set fire to an entity. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:extinguish.d: Extinguish blocks in a large area. Costs about six Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:conjure_block.d: Conjure an ethereal, but solid, block that sparkles with my pigment at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:conjure_light.d: Conjure a magical light that softly glows with my pigment at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:bonemeal.d: Encourage a plant or sapling at the target position to grow, as if Bonemeal was applied. Costs a bit more than one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:edify.d: Forcibly infuse media into the sapling at the target position, causing it to grow into an Edified Tree. Costs about one Charged Amethyst.

hexcasting:beep.d: Remove a vector and two numbers from the stack. Plays an instrument defined by the first number at the given location, with a note defined by the second number. Costs a negligible amount of media.

hexcasting:sentinel/create.d: Summons my sentinel at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:sentinel/get_pos.d: Add the position of my sentinel to the stack, or Null if it isn't summoned. Costs a negligible amount of media.

hexcasting:sentinel/wayfind.d: Transform the position vector on the top of the stack into a unit vector pointing from that position to my sentinel, or Null if it isn't summoned. Costs a negligible amount of media.

hexcasting:akashic/read.d: Read the iota associated with the given pattern out of the Akashic Library with its Record at the given position. This has no range limit. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:akashic/write.d: Associate the iota with the given pattern in the Akashic Library with its Record at the given position. This *does* have a range limit. Costs about one Amethyst Dust.

hexcasting:const/vec/px.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (1, 0, 0) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (-1, 0, 0).

hexcasting:const/vec/py.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (0, 1, 0) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (0, -1, 0).

hexcasting:const/vec/pz.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (0, 0, 1); the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (0, 0, -1).

hexcasting:const/vec/nx.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (1, 0, 0) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (-1, 0, 0).

hexcasting:const/vec/ny.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (0, 1, 0) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (0, -1, 0).

hexcasting:const/vec/nz.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (0, 0, 1); the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (0, 0, -1).

hexcasting:compare_block/lenient.d: Compare the blocks specified by the given vectors and push whether they are of the same type. Two Edified Stairs will always compare as equal regardless of their shape or if they are waterlogged.

hexcasting:compare_block/strict.d: Compare the blocks specified by the given vectors and push whether they appear to be identical. Two placed Edified Stairs will only compare as equal if they appear exactly the same.

complexhex:qmake.d: Pushes a Quaternion with num as the real coefficient and the vector's x, y, & z as the coefficients of i, j & k respectively.

complexhex:qunmake.d: Pushes the real coefficient and a vector where the x, y, & z components are the coefficients of i, j, & k respectively.

complexhex:axisangle.d: Pushes a quaternion that reperesents a rotation by the given angle num radias around the given vector.

complexhex:translatebit.d: Translates the BIT to the given offset.

complexhex:scalebit.d: Scales the BIT to the given vector.

complexhex:summon/line.d: Summons a parametric line at the given position. The expression given will have a t-value (0-1), x/y/z position, and time (w) substituted in and must resolve to a vector on the line.

complexhex:summon/surface.d: Summons a parametric surface at the given position. The expression given will have a u&v-value (0-1), x/y/z position, and time (w) substituted in and must resolve to a vector on the surface

hexkeys:get_noetic_bookshelf_ref.d: Adds a reference to a noetic bookshelf to the stack. This reference may be used for targeting in place of a vector for noetic spells

hexkeys:concat_noetic_bookshelf.d: Concatenate a list onto the end of a noetic shelf

hexways:summonscry.d: Works as a 1-way portal, but does not provide travel, only sight. Costs increase with distance, though noticeably less than for other portals.

hexways:moveportalinput.d: Takes a portal and location vector, and moves its input to that location. The cost is slightly lesser than portal creation, and is reduced for scrying portals.

hexways:getoutputinfo.d: This nifty pattern returns a portal's output location as a vector (which will be the location of the output portal, for a 2-way portal). This could be useful combined with Portal Ambit. Costs no media.

hex_ars_link:cast_spell_shoot.d:
Cast the given spell as a projectile shooting from certain position & angle. One Glyph of Projectile will be inserted before the given glyphs.
Costs 1 shard plus 1 dust for each glyph used.

hex_ars_link:cast_spell_touch.d:
Cast the given spell on given entity or position. One Glyph of Touch will be inserted before the given glyphs.
Costs 1 shard plus 1 dust for each glyph used.

hexstruction:save_structure.d:
Removes the locations of two corners from the stack, then consumes a region of space defined by those two corners, storing the result in a Structure iota.
Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust for every block consumed.

hexstruction:load_structure.d:
Removes the location of the structure's origin and a structure from the stack, then attempts to place the structure at the origin, erasing the structure from all memory. Mishaps if any part of the structure overlaps with another block.
Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust for every block placed.

hexstruction:display_structure.d: Removes the location of the structure's origin and a structure from the stack, followed by a duration between 0 and 72000.

hexal:everbook/read.d: Takes the position of an Akashic Record, as well as a Pattern as a key, and retrieves the iota at that key from your Everbook, storing it in the given Akashic Record if able.

hexal:everbook/write.d: Takes the position of an Akashic Record, as well as a Pattern as a key, and stores the iota in that record at that key to your Everbook at the same key.

hexal:freeze.d: Freezes the block at a block location. For example, turns water into ice, and ice into packed ice. Costs one Amethyst Dust.

hexal:falling_block.d: Remove a location from the stack, and force the block there to fall as if it were sand or gravel. Costs one and a half Amethyst Dust.

hexal:place_type.d: Accepts an item type or mote and a location, and attempts to place a block of that item type at that location. If a mote was passed it will instead place from the record referenced by that mote. Costs an eighth of an Amethyst Dust.

hexal:particles.d: Accepts a location or a list of locations, and either creates a particle at the location, or creates lines of particles between the locations in the list. Costs two thousandths of an Amethyst Dust per location.

hexal:gate/close.d: Consumes a non-drifing gate iota, or a drifting gate iota and a position. Transports all the entities marked with the passed gate to the stored or given position, as relevant. Costs half an Amethyst Shard, plus an Amethyst Dust per metre transported per entity, if the gate was drifting.

hexal:mote/storage/bind.d: Target a Mote Nexus block in the world and bind yourself to it, meaning all items you mediafy will be added to that nexus' capacity. Targeting any other block will unbind you from your currently bound nexus. Costs 32 Amethyst Dust.

hexal:mote/storage/bind/temp.d: Target a Mote Nexus block in the world and bind to it for the remainder of this cast, temporarily overriding your primary binding. Costs one thousandth of an Amethyst Dust.

hexal:mote/storage/contains.d: Returns true if the Mote Nexus at the given position contains a mote of the given type, or that would stack with the given mote, and false otherwise.

hexal:mote/storage/get.d: Get the position of the Mote Nexus that contains the passed mote.

hexal:mote/storage/set.d: Move the record referenced by the passed mote to the Mote Nexus at the passed position. This returns a new mote pointing to that record, and invalidates all previous motes pointing to that record.

hexal:mote/use_on.d: Accepts a mote, and either an entity, or a target block and a normal vector. Uses the item on the entity/block. The mote must either only have one item in it, or the items contained must be extremely simple (no NBT data).

hexal:interop/fabric_only/phase_block.d: Takes a position and a number, and phases the block at that position out for that many seconds. Costs one ten-thousandth of an Amethyst Dust times the square of the time to phase out for.

hexodus:alter_ballast.d: Commands a Ballast on my person to fall in a given direction with a given strength strength. Free.

hexodus:get_direction.d: Pushes the direction that Gravitate is attempting to drag an entity, or Null if the entity is not under the effects of Gravitate. | Pushes the direction that Gravitate is attempting to drag a Ship, or Null if the Ship is not under the effects of Gravitate.

hexodus:get_true_direction.d: Pushes the direction of Gravity acting on an entity. | Pushes the direction of Gravity acting on a Ship.

hexpose:text_color.d: Takes a text iota and a color encoded as a vector whose components range from 0 to 1, and produces a text iota of that color.

hexpose:fluid_raycast.d: Works similar to Archer's Distillation but targets only liquids, piercing through all other blocks.

hexpose:fluid_surface_raycast.d: Works similar to Architect's Distillation but targets only liquids, piercing through all other blocks.

hexpose:theodolite.d: Similar to Alidade's Purification but pushes the vector that points upwards from their head rather than the entity's facing vector.

hexpose:get_light.d: Pushes the light level at the position as a number 0 to 15. If inside a nontransparent block, it returns zero.

hexpose:get_power.d: Pushes the Redstone power that a position receives.

hexpose:get_comparator.d: Pushes the power level a Comparator would output if pressed against a position.

hexpose:get_biome.d: Pushes the identifier of the type of biome the vector is within.

hextrapats:rot_about/x.d: Rotates the vector by the given angle in radians around the X axis.

hextrapats:rot_about/y.d: Rotates the vector by the given angle in radians around the Y axis.

hextrapats:rot_about/z.d: Rotates the vector by the given angle in radians around the Z axis.

hextrapats:cons_about/x.d: Converts an angle in radians to a unit vector where X=0. +Z at 0 radians and +Y at pi/4 radians.

hextrapats:cons_about/y.d: Converts an angle in radians to a unit vector where Y=0. +Z at 0 radians and -X at pi/4 radians. I've seen some texts related to this pattern mentioning something called F3, but I couldn't figure out what that means.

hextrapats:cons_about/z.d: Converts an angle in radians to a unit vector where Z=0. -X at 0 radians and +Y at pi/4 radians.

hextrapats:normalize.d: Sets the length of the vector to one.

hextrapats:len_eq.d: If the two vectors are the same length (within small tolerance), return True. Otherwise, return False.

hextrapats:len_neq.d: If the two vectors are not the same length (outside small tolerance), return True. Otherwise, return False.

hextrapats:in_range.d: If the first number is between the second and third, return True. Otherwise, return False. If the first value is a vector, compare its length instead.

hextrapats:out_range.d: If the first number is not between the second and third, return True. Otherwise, return False. If the first value is a vector, compare its length instead.

hextrapats:increment.d: Adds 1. | Increases length by 1. Does nothing if the vector is (0, 0, 0).

hextrapats:decrement.d: Subtracts by 1. | Decreases length by 1. Does nothing if the vector is (0, 0, 0).

hextrapats:approach.d: Moves the first value closer to the second by the given amount. Will not overshoot. | Moves the first vector towards the second by a given distance. Will not overshoot.
hextrapats:approach.i: num, num, num | vec, vec, num

hextrapats:angle_dist.d: Returns the shortest angular distance between two angles in radians. | Returns the shortest angular distance on a sphere between two vectors in radians

hextrapats:angle_approach.d: Turns the first angle towards the second by the given number of radians, picking whichever direction is shorter. | Rotates the first vector towards the direction of the second vector by the given number of radians. Mishaps if the two directions are directly opposite to each other.
hextrapats:angle_approach.i: num, num, num | vec, vec, num

hextrapats:vec/get/x.d: Returns the X, Y, or Z component of a vector.

hextrapats:vec/get/y.d: Returns the X, Y, or Z component of a vector.

hextrapats:vec/get/z.d: Returns the X, Y, or Z component of a vector.

hextrapats:vec/set/x.d: Overrides a vector's X, Y, or Z component.

hextrapats:vec/set/y.d: Overrides a vector's X, Y, or Z component.

hextrapats:vec/set/z.d: Overrides a vector's X, Y, or Z component.

hextrapats:round/int.d: Rounds a number to the nearest integer. If passed a vector, rounds each of its components instead.

hextrapats:round/exact.d: Rounds a number to the nearest multiple of the second number. If passed a vector, rounds each of its components instead.

hextrapats:rand_vec.d: Returns a unit vector facing a random direction.

hextrapats:vec_dist.d: Returns the distance between two vectors.

hextrapats:from_polar.d: Creates a unit vector from two polar angles, pitch and yaw, in radians. +Y is up. 0 yaw is +Z, pi/2 yaw is -X. Yet again, mentions of F3 turn up.

hextrapats:to_polar.d: Converts a vector's direction into two polar angles, pitch and yaw, in radians. +Y is up. 0 yaw is +Z, pi/2 yaw is -X. Yet again, mentions of F3 turn up.

hextrapats:swap_vec_list.d: Converts a list of 3 numbers to a vector, or a vector into a list of 3 numbers.

hextrapats:haha_ha_one.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (1, 1, 1) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (-1, -1, -1).

hextrapats:eno_ah_ahah.d: The left-hand counter-clockwise pattern adds (1, 1, 1) to the stack; the right-hand clockwise pattern adds (-1, -1, -1).

hextrapats:empty_set/vec.d: Push an empty set that can hold vectors to the top of the stack.

hextrogen:dash.d: Compels my mind to Dash according to the normalized vector. Cancels my velocity if given the zero vector. Free. If I am out of Dashes, does nothing. Requires Estrogen.

hexxyskies:pos.d: Takes a position on a Ship and returns the associated Ship.

hexxyskies:zone_ship.d: Analogous to Zone Distillation, but instead returns a list of Ships.

hexxyskies:com/world.d: Analogous to Compass Purification, but instead returns the position of a Ship's Center of Mass in World Space.

hexxyskies:com/model.d: Analogous to Compass Purification, but instead returns the position of a Ship's Center of Mass in Model Space.

hexxyskies:mass.d: Takes either a Ship or a block location and returns the Ship's mass and the block's mass respectively.

hexxyskies:rot/euler.d: Returns the Ship's orientation as Euler Angles using the YXZ reference frame in radians.

hexxyskies:aabb.d:
Returns the minimum and maximum corners of the Ship's AABB in Model Space.
Maybe using this with Hexstruction would allow you to disassemble the Ship...

hexxyskies:assemble.d: Takes in a list of positions to use to create a Ship. All positions must be in ambit. The cost is one shard per position. | Takes a mesh and creates a Ship from its points. All positions must be in ambit. The cost is one shard per position.

hexxyskies:force/world.d: Applies a Force at a given World Space position. The position is any offset from the Center of Mass in World Space.

hexxyskies:torque/world.d: Applies a Torque specified by the vector in World Space.

hexxyskies:force/model.d: Applies a Force at a given Model Space position. The position is any offset from the Center of Mass in Model Space.

hexxyskies:torque/model.d: Applies a Torque specified by the vector in Model Space

hexxyskies:force/body.d: Applies a Force at a given Body Space position. The position is any offset from the Center of Mass in Body Space which is always (0, 0, 0).

hexxyskies:torque/body.d: Applies a Torque specified by the vector in Body Space.

hexxyplanes:plane_pos.d: Gets the spawn position within this plane as a vector.

hexxyplanes:plane_exit.d: Marks the target location as my exit for the hexplane, or resets it to be my spawn location if passed null, causing me to be sent there upon using Planar Expulsion on myself.

hexxyplanes:exit_deconstruct.d: Puts the dimension and the coordinates of my hexplane exit onto the stack.

hierophantics:make_velocity_trigger.d: Creates a trigger that activates when my velocity (measured in blocks per tick) exceeds the specified value.

hierophantics:invert_trigger.d: Inverts the threshold on a numerical trigger. For example, 'When velocity exceeds 5.0' will become 'When velocity drops below 5.0'. Has no effect on other types of triggers.

movesthemind:create.d: Bids the creature to the given location. Costs a charged amethyst.

movesthemind:move/look.d: Instructs the creature to look in a direction. The vector can be of any length. Seems to work on myself in the eyes of Nature, even though I don't feel or see the change.

efhexs:play_sound.d: Plays a sound at a particular location, volume, and pitch. Costs about a sixteenth of an Amethyst Dust.

efhexs:play_particle.d: Conjures a particular particle with a specified position and velocity (blocks per twentieth of a second). Costs about 1/32th of an Amethyst Dust.

efhexs:play_dust_particle.d: Conjures a small mote of dust of a given color. The number relates vaguely to scale and lifespan.

efhexs:play_hex_particle.d: Conjures a blob of visible media, not unlike the waste product of my Hexes. Takes in a color.

efhexs:play_potion_effect.d: Conjures a swirling particle like the ones that emanate from me when I am under the effects of a potion. Takes in a color.

efhexs:play_item_pickup.d: Conjures an illusion of the given item iota at the location and makes it fly into the given entity before disappearing, as though the entity had picked it up.
